{{Quest|Recover Sulphur}} |abiphone = Yes |location = [[Mage Council]] |location_page_description = Appears here during the [[Mage Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]] to discuss stolen research. |x = -121.5 |y = 82 |z = -756.5 |location2 = [[Burning Desert]] |location_page_description2 = Appears here during the [[Mage Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]] to find the lost [[Apprentice (Crimson Isle)|Apprentice]]. |x2 = -526.5 |y2 = 86 |z2 = -885.5 |location3 = [[Crimson Isle]] |location_page_description3 = Appears here during the [[Mage Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]] next to the lost [[Apprentice (Crimson Isle)|Apprentice]]. |x3 = -522.86 |y3 = 104 |z3 = -918.8 |minimap_location3 = Burning Desert |location4 = The Wasteland |location_page_description4 = Appears here at the end of the [[Crimson Isle Main Questline]]. |x4 = -373.5 |y4 = 117 |z4 = -977.5 |location5 = Forgotten Skull |location_page_description5 = Appears here at the end of the [[Crimson Isle Main Questline]] after defeating [[Kuudra]]. |x5 = -373.5 |y5 = 113 |z5 = -1036.5 }} '''Captain Ahone''' is an [[NPC]] found throughout the {{Zone|Crimson Isle}} primarily during the [[Mage Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]], as well as at the end of both [[Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questlines]]. == Quest == '''Captain Ahone''' first appears during the [[Mage Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]] when the player is sent to the {{Zone|Mage Council}} to meet about stolen research. Later in the quest, he appears in the {{Zone|Burning Desert}} with a {{Item|Small Backpack}}, after {{NPCSprite|Dean}} tasks the player with finding the lost {{NPCSprite|Apprentice (Crimson Isle);Apprentice}}. Their [[Abiphone]] contact gets added to the player's Abiphone, instructing them to call upon finding the Apprentice. When this happens, he then walks up to the Apprentice with {{NPCSprite|Grelius}} and {{NPCSprite|Krevius}}, splashes him with healing potions, and then disappears, tasking the player player with reporting back to {{NPCSprite|Dean}}. Towards the end of the quest, {{NPCSprite|Dean}} tasks the player with calling Captain Ahone, who then instructs the player to meet them by the {{Zone|Forgotten Skull}}. He can then be found there with several other [[NPCs]], who all agree to investigate [[Kuudra]]. This ending also occurs at the end of the [[Barbarian Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]]. After defeating [[Kuudra]] for the first time as part of either quest, they then appear in the {{Zone|Forgotten Skull}} with {{NPCSprite|Ugo}} and {{NPCSprite|Elle}}, disappearing after you continue the quest. == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable" !
